description:
Investigate a security incident where a failed login attempt was detected for the admin account. 

1. Login to FreeScout (admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!) if not already logged in.
2. Navigate to the System Logs.
3. Locate the most recent 'Failed login' event for the admin user.
4. Identify the source IP address of this attempt.
5. Save ONLY the IP address to a file named 'suspicious_ip.txt' in the '/home/ga/' directory.
